test_efficient_pnp: test the efficient_pnp function from pytorch3d.ops.perspective_n_points with 3D world points and 2D projections
test_weighted_pnp: test the efficient_pnp function with binary weights to ignore certain 2D-3D point correspondences
generate_epnp_test_data: generate synthetic EPnP test data including x_world, x_cam, R, and T from random 2D projections
compute_reprojection_error: compute the weighted reprojection error between predicted and ground truth 2D projections after applying camera transform
run_pnp_benchmark: run a benchmark of efficient_pnp on CUDA with synchronized timing for performance measurement
